description: Election Commission - Declare that N. G. M. A. De Silva as Member of the Galle Municipal Council
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a municipal council under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for a local government body, including the declaration of a new member to fill a seat that became vacant due to a party membership change. This falls squarely under Election-related matters, specifically addressing candidate selection and declaration processes.
